ideas.title: Minnesota Construction Firm Wage Theft Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate construction firms in Minnesota for potential wage theft and underpayment of workers
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover potential fraud and underpayment of workers by construction firms in Minnesota
questions: How widespread is the wage theft?
What are the consequences for the firms involved?
ideas.insight: This story idea has high potential for uncovering fraud and abuse in the construction industry in Minnesota. The recent $1.28M wage recovery by the Minnesota labor agency is just the tip of the iceberg.
